decisions: NEW-1 resolved per the blueprint: canvasLeaves lists exactly one active region leaf, `marquee` (04 §5.2 too), so the rectangle-marquee tool and the freehand-lasso tool both live in that one leaf instead of inventing a second leaf.

The confidence gate is derived, not stored: `extraction='ocr'` + `confidence < 0.70` (or null) is `needs-correction` via `isResultEligible()`. A below-gate mark still writes, so the user keeps the mark; the Result engine (020) excludes it. No new column invented (db §8.1 only has `confidence`).

OCR is fail-soft: `recognizeRegion` never throws; a missing worker/network returns `{text:'', confidence:0}` (below gate) so an offline region still saves. Tesseract's 0-100 confidence is normalized to 0-1 at the seam, so the gate is one number.

PageStage's `touch-action` was corrected to 03 §7: `none` only while a draw tool is armed, otherwise `touch-pan-x touch-pan-y`. Task 009 had pinned `touch-none` globally, which is exactly the 'scrolling dies' case 03 §7 warns about; the leaf now toggles it and page-stage.test pins both states.
PageStage gained `onCanvasRendered` so a features-level container can crop z0 for OCR without a canvas leaf importing `@feature/*` (I3). It mirrors 010's `onTextLayerRendered` seam.
Bbox.tool was widened to `text_layer | rect | freehand`; the stored `color` stays `null` (the live-stroke colour is a rendering concern; highlight-layer resolves the token like 010).
The marquee renders nothing at all when disarmed and fixture-free, so a page with no draw tool adds no Konva layer and its pan/zoom is untouched — g2's acceptance is structural, not just behavioural.
Pending region marks join the same highlight-layer render path as text highlights (isBbox accepts the new tools), so no separate painter was needed for stored regions.
